name: context-menu
title: ContextMenu
description: Styled Solid context menu backed by Keystone menu navigation, typeahead, and overlay behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through ui-context-menu classes while Core owns menu roles, roving focus, typeahead, dismissal, and positioning.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers menu roles, roving focus, typeahead, disabled skipping, submenu-capable item structure, context trigger positioning, dismissal, and UI classes. Gaps: pointer grace areas, collision-aware submenu placement, checkbox/radio item groups, animation status metadata, and nested layer edge tests remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid ContextMenu/Menu anatomy direction with trigger, portal/content, items, separators, groups, and keyboard navigation. Gaps: advanced submenu intent, modality nuances, item checked state helpers, and deeper dismissable-layer coordination remain follow-up work.
